label: s2_side01_0020_rival_00
text: That was such a great meal. Can’t believe we\ngot all that after we barged in outta nowhere![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Your mom’s cooking is so good,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_botan_01
text: Right? And she’s so pretty, my brain literally\nglitched when I saw her.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_01
text: I’m so glad she remembered me![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_02
text: And look at this huge room! Doesn’t make you\nfeel all boxed in like the dorm rooms do.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_03
text: It’s super cute, seriously... Almost too much for\nme to take![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_botan_02
text: Oooh, it’s a Nintendo Switch! You HAVE to tell\nme what games you’ve got on this thing![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_02
text: I love this Skwovet plush! This fluff’s to die for![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_01
text: How’s everybody doing? Anyone want dessert?\nI was thinking of bringing up some sweets...[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_botan_03
text: Sweets?! Yesss![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_04
text: N-n-no way! We couldn’t possibly ask you for\nmore food! We don’t mean to be a hustle!\r\nHassle, I mean! We don’t want to be a hassle![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_02
text: Hehe! Oh, sweetie, no need to stand on\nceremony here![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_03
text: Just make yourselves at home and relax![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_05
text: Y-yes, ma’am![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_04
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh, and [VAR 0x0100(0000)]—a letter came\nfor\r\nyou.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_05
text: It’s from...“Kieran.” Do you know a Kieran?[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_06
text: My word, you’ve been making plenty of friends![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_07
text: Really? Well, that’s odd... Still, it WAS addressed\nto you, so I suppose I shouldn’t read it.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_08
text: Here you are.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_09
text: I’ll bring those sweets up in just a few. I hope\nyou’ll all enjoy them![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_03
text: I’ll come help![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_botan_04
text: Gah, I wanna check out the sweets, too![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_06
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Your mom sure is nice,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]...
You’re
real
lucky...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_07
text: Oh, but what about that letter? Aren’t you gonna\nat least open it up?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_system_01
text:
Dear [VAR 0x0100(0000)],

How are you doing lately? I took a leave from
school, so I’m back in Mossui Town for a while.
My sis came back with me, too.

label: s2_side01_0020_system_02
text:
I know we didn’t get much chance to talk after
everything that happened in the underdepths. I’d
really like to catch up. Think you could swing a
visit to Kitakami? Carmine would love to see you,
I’m sure—maybe you could bring your friends
from Paldea, too. I included plenty of tickets.

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_08
text: Who’s this Kieran guy? Some new...friend or\nsomething?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_select_01
text: Yeah, just a friend

label: s2_side01_0020_select_02
text: Yeah, he’s...a friend

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_09
text: Yeah? I mean...guess that’s good for you and all.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_10
text: What’s with the weird hesitation? There some\nkind of story there? Not that it’s my business...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_04
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Arven! You are not gonna
BELIEVE
how
good
this
stuff looks![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_05
text: There’s too much to carry upstairs! C’mon down\nhere and eat![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_11
text: Sheesh, that Nemona... Hasn’t she ever heard of\nan inside voice?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_12
text: But I guess we’d better go, or she’ll just keep on\nshouting![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_botan_05
text: Oooh, my poor gut... I feel like I’ll burst if I eat\nanother bite...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_13
text: I think what you’re trying to say is “Thank you so\nmuch for feeding us. It was all really delicious!”\c\nRight?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_06
text: I’ll help with the dishes and stuff![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_10
text: Oh, aren’t you the sweetest thing! But no need\nto lift a finger. You kids just take it easy.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_07
text: Thanks, ma’am! You’re the best![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_14
text: At least Nemona’s got manners, I’ll give her that.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_15
text: Unlike this one...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_botan_06
text: Huh? Why’re you looking at me?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_16
text: Say, [VAR 0x0100(0000)], about that letter...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_17
text: What was that place your new pal mentioned?\nKitakami or something?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_18
text: You really gonna go there to meet this Kieran\nguy again?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_select_03
text: Yeah, let’s all go!

label: s2_side01_0020_select_04
text: We should go together!

label: s2_side01_0020_botan_07
text: Wait, what? You going somewhere?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_08
text: Did we miss something? Something good?!\nSpill it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_09
text: Are you serious?! We’re DEFINITELY going\nwith you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_10
text: This Kieran kid was Champion of a super elite\nbattle academy, right?! I’ve got to meet him![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_botan_08
text: More like “I’ve got to BATTLE him”...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_11
text: Was it that obvious?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_20
text: I feel kinda bad, though. Like we just invited\nourselves along on your trip without asking...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_12
text: The guy said to bring friends, and WE’RE\nthose friends! He even sent tickets for us![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_botan_09
text: Yup. “Friends” equals us. Ergo, we get the tickets.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_13
text: You bet we do![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_botan_10
text: This’ll be my first time going on a trip with\nfriends...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0020_botan_12
text: It’s kind of...scary and exciting at the same time.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_21
text: Yeah, now that you mention it, I don’t think\nI’ve ever taken a trip with a friend either.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_14
text: You’re kidding! Well, this is gonna be AMAZING,\nso get excited![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_15
text: Guess I better at least tell the housekeeper\nover at my place I’ll be away for a while.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_rival_16
text: Why don’t we break for now, do whatever\nprep we gotta do, and meet up again later?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0020_friend_22
text: Sounds good! Let’s say...we meet up again in\nfront of [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Mesagoza’s southern gate[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0020_botan_13
text: Roger. See you all later, then![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0020_all_01
text: Thanks for having us over![VAR 0x0114(004C)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_11
text: Oh, did Nemona and the others leave already?[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_12
text: Your friends are all such nice kids. I was really\nglad to meet them all.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_13
text: And now it sounds like you’re all about to go\nhave a little adventure together, hm?[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: s2_side01_0020_mama_14
text: Well, have fun if you do! No fighting, and be\nsure to look after one another![VAR 0x0114(002B)]
